# Shivam Rohilla

> Full-Stack Developer and AI Automation Engineer based in Noida, India.

Shivam Rohilla specializes in n8n workflow automation, GPT-4o-mini and Claude API
integrations, Flask and React full-stack development, and AWS cloud infrastructure.
He has built production automation systems handling 200+ franchise locations.
